title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet, Solid Brass | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep bath towels within reach without drilling into walls—this freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet creates instant hanging space right where you need it.

  • Organize more towels in less space with 4 pivoting swing arms that spread out for airflow and fold in when not in use.
  • Place it anywhere in the bathroom thanks to a freestanding design that requires no wall mounting.
  • Stay steady on the floor with a large weighted base designed to help prevent tipping.
  • Built for enduring use with solid brass construction designed to resist rust and corrosion.
  • Coordinate matching pieces with the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection and multiple designer finish options.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 10.5 in.
  • Shipping weight: 17 lbs
  • Some assembly required
  • Limited lifetime warranty
  • Made in the USA
